name: Study Plan
description: Creates structured, time-boxed study plans with sessions, topics, milestones, and review checkpoints for learners. Uses spaced learning principles to produce a personalized schedule that prevents cramming and builds lasting retention. Use when a student or learner asks to create a study plan, organize their study time, prepare for a course, or structure their learning around a deadline. Do NOT use for exam-specific preparation (use `exam-prep-plan`), for educator lesson planning (use `lesson-plan-design`), or for professional certification study (use `certification-prep`).
